description:
Open the employee handbook at /home/ga/Documents/employee_handbook.docx and perform the following 5 systematic Find & Replace corrections:

1. Replace all double spaces ("  ") with single spaces.
2. Standardize company name: Replace "Greenfield industries" (lowercase 'i') with "Greenfield Industries" (uppercase 'I'). Be careful not to change instances that are already correct.
3. Update email domain: Replace "@greenfield-ind.com" with "@greenfieldind.com".
4. Expand abbreviations: Replace "dept." (case-insensitive) with "Department".
5. Update policy year: Replace "2019" with "2024".

Save the corrected document as a NEW file at /home/ga/Documents/employee_handbook_corrected.docx. Do not overwrite the original.
